description_en: Deletes a database account from an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 删除集群的数据库账号
kebab_example: aliyun adb delete-account --db-cluster-id amv-bp11q28kvl6880000 --account-name test_accout --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteAccount

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition cluster
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版的集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database account.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612430.html operation to query the information about database accounts for a cluster, including the account name
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号名称。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612430.html接口查看指定集群的数据库账号信息，包括账号名称
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The database engine of the cluster. Valid values:

AnalyticDB (default): the AnalyticDB for MySQL engine.
Clickhouse: the wide table engine
parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎，取值：

AnalyticDB（默认）：AnalyticDB MySQL引擎。
Clickhouse：宽表引擎
parameters.name: engine
